2607.25299.title: Retraction-Free Optimization over the Stiefel Manifold for the LoRA Fine-Tuning
2607.25299.paper_summary: Optimization over the Stiefel manifold plays a significant role in various machine learning tasks. Existing methods either use the retraction operators, requiring costly orthonormalization for large-scale matrices, or employ landing methods that rely on careful step size selection and penalty parameter tuning. To address these challenges, we propose a retraction-free and penalty parameter-free algorithm that directly lands on the manifold. By leveraging the strongly-convex-like property of the quadratic penalty function and the proximal smoothness of the Stiefel manifold, we establish global convergence guarantees with the best-known iteration complexities under both constant and diminishing step sizes. Then, we reformulate the low-rank adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning problem for large language models as a manifold optimization problem, introducing Manifold-LoRA for geometry-accelerated adaptation. This approach employs the proposed landing technique and a carefully designed step size strategy to accelerate the training process. Numerical experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the efficiency and strong downstream performance of the proposed method.
2607.25299.paper_summary_zh: 優化在 Stiefel 流形上的應用在各種機器學習任務中扮演著重要角色。現有的方法要麼使用回縮運算子，這對於大規模矩陣需要耗費高昂的正交化成本，要麼採用依賴於仔細步長選擇和懲罰參數調整的著陸方法。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了一種無需回縮和懲罰參數的算法，該算法可以直接著陸於流形上。通過利用二次懲罰函數的強凸性質和 Stiefel 流形的近端光滑性，我們在恆定和遞減步長下建立了全球收斂保證，並提供了最佳已知的迭代複雜度。然後，我們將大型語言模型的低秩適應（LoRA）微調問題重新表述為流形優化問題，引入了 Manifold-LoRA 以實現幾何加速適應。這種方法採用了所提出的著陸技術和精心設計的步長策略，以加速訓練過程。在基準數據集上的數值實驗證明了所提方法的效率和強大的下游性能。
